notes.claim: For a six-pulse bridge the characteristic harmonic currents are of order 6n plus or minus 1: 5, 7, 11, 13, 17, 19.
A drive's intermediate-circuit capacitors need 5 minutes to discharge after power is disconnected, before work continues (one maker's instruction).
If an RCD protects against electric shock on a three-phase variable speed drive, only a type B RCD is allowed (one maker's instruction).
Drive EMC filters and ground-to-phase varistors are not suitable for IT (ungrounded) systems and must be disconnected (one maker's manual).
Lead-acid batteries being recharged generate hydrogen, explosive in air between 4.1 and 72 percent hydrogen.
The total harmonic distortion of a ship's electrical distribution is not to exceed 8 percent.
Six-pulse converters draw 25 to 40 percent current THD, 12-pulse 9 to 11 percent and 18-pulse 3 to 4 percent.
The two largest harmonic currents of a six-pulse drive are the fifth and the seventh.
THD is the ratio of the rms of the harmonics' magnitudes to the rms magnitude of the fundamental.
THD is quoted with I for current or V for voltage, for example 35% THDI and 4% THDV (a lecture's example figures).
As a rough rule of thumb, each harmonic current is the fundamental current divided by the harmonic number (a secondary source).
A reactor is valuable for limiting the harmonic currents produced by variable speed drives and other non-linear loads.
Regular harmonic distortion measurements on ships are essential to detect an incipient failure (of harmonic filters).
One maker's drive needs at least 15 minutes for its DC-link capacitors to discharge, then a measurement to confirm no voltage.
High voltage may be present even when a drive's indicator LED is not lit (one maker's note).
Type B (or B-Si) RCDs are particularly suitable for three-phase variable speed drives, protecting against fault currents with DC offset, which three-phase converters give.
A Type A RCD detects only sinusoidal AC and pulsating DC residual currents (a secondary source).
BS 7671 Regulation 531.3.3 covers the use of Type AC, A, F and B RCDs.
A drive whose normal touch current exceeds 3.5 mA AC or 10 mA DC needs its protective earth conductor sized to the rules for high protective earthing conductor current.
On an insulated (IT) supply a first earth fault produces no notable return current path and so no dangerous contact voltage.
On an insulated (IT) supply the insulation monitoring device monitors the entire electrically connected circuit for insulation faults.
Insulation monitors are used on IT networks with UPS systems, frequency inverters and battery networks.
An insulation monitor alarm at start-up only can come from common-mode filter capacitors charging through the monitor (a secondary source).
Low-cost drive filters can create leakage current high enough to clash with an installation's safety requirements.
For i8: a 30 mA RCD may operate anywhere between 50% and 100% of its rating, 15 mA to 30 mA, so a 28.7 mA leakage would very likely trip it and 19.1 mA could.
For i8: for the least radio interference, bond a drive's motor cable screen all round (360 degrees) where it enters the motor terminal box.
